generations.name: Legacy evolving prototype
generations.definition: Iterations 1-8 before the architecture and evidence protocol were frozen.

generations.name: Governed independent-agent simulation
generations.treatment: Independent role memory, structured cognition, responsibility dispatch, authority constraints, evidence-grounded task state and convergence governance.
generations.baseline: Independent conventional role agents with isolated rolling public-history memory and no RoomMind governance.

candidate_versions.evidence: Batch 44a9e7b3-05e8-4903-ad01-42a67e7f0134 exposed a deterministic empty-memory baseline defect and cumulative empty-output failures.

candidate_versions.changes: First-turn memory normalization, bounded cognitive context, reflection cooldown, quota-aware decision suppression, typed empty-output recovery, degradation telemetry, and persistent worker heartbeat.
candidate_versions.evidence: Batch 86f74b31-22ba-4af2-a4a9-7513eb5cce1b completed 24/24 runs but did not outperform the independent-agent baseline; procedural loops motivated G2.

generations.name: Coordinated governed independent-agent simulation
generations.treatment: G1.1 independent role cognition plus a deterministic per-turn focus and ownership coordinator, commitment ageing, confirmed-state locking, responsibility-prioritized routing, and structured closeout pressure.
generations.baseline: The same independent conventional role-agent baseline retained from G1, with per-agent rolling public-history memory and no RoomMind governance.

candidate_versions.changes: Introduces a deterministic coordination layer without sharing role-private memories or inventing domain outcomes.

generations.activation_evidence: G1.1 batch 86f74b31-22ba-4af2-a4a9-7513eb5cce1b: 11/12 RoomMind sessions stopped by safety/stagnation governance and procedural fidelity trailed Baseline by 1.25 points.

planned_generations.theme: Fact registry and explicit role decision policy
planned_generations.activation_rule: Create only when fact provenance or role decision architecture materially changes.
